This browser build keeps expanding into a bigger city-destruction sandbox. It is a fresh web prototype, not a direct clone.

ControlsClick or tap to use the selected disaster. Hold for repeatable tools, press S or tap ⚙ to tune the active power, and press G to toggle the city crowd.
PowersCore disasters plus genre tabs for Creature and Future, adding Godzilla, Kong, Tripods, and the Death Star. Creature spawns now brawl each other automatically.
MapsCycle Metro, Coast, and Winter to match the look of your screenshots.
Keys1-0, -, = core tools, Q/W/E creature tools, F Death Star, C cycle genre, R reset, T theme, P pause, S tuning, G crowd toggle.
